text: Regulation targeted only at retail investors is misdirected, because incomplete and asymmetric information, bounded rationality, and moral hazard make it difficult even for professional and semi professional investors to discern the characteristics of highly complex instruments and hard-to-value assets.
citation: Kaal, Hedge Fund Valuation Retailization, Regulation, and Investor Suitability (2009). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1428387
